oneOf.description:
Writable without asking (the engine's sandbox allowlist plus
allow rules for `write`/`edit`).
The engine's own ask flow decides (the same as no entry).
Blocked in every mode, for bash and the file tools alike.

auto_review.description:
Let the engine's fast model auto-allow unmistakably safe commands
(it never denies; anything uncertain still asks you). Off by default.

daily_tokens.description:
Daily token cap (input+output+cache); the only cap that binds for
unpriced models.

daily_usd.description: Daily USD cap across sessions (ka usage accounting).

digest_time.description: Local clock time (operator zone) of the daily digest, `HH:MM`.

default_role.description: The role an auto-provisioned workspace user gets.

shared_channel_role.description:
The role a shared-channel turn runs as (never a user's own memory or
grants leak into a shared surface). Default: the built-in `channel`
role (read-only, no personal data).

Checkpoint.description:
Shadow-git checkpoints (`[checkpoint]`, v4 B1): the safety net under
approved writes.

enabled.description:
Snapshot the workspace before every approved write. `false` turns
the net off entirely (`/rewind` answers "no checkpoints").

keep_days.description:
How long checkpoint rows and their shadow repos live (Gemini's
documented 30-day default); pruning is destructive.

DiscordSettings.description: The Discord bot (`[discord]`): gateway WebSocket, guild allowlist.

api_base.description: API base (tests point it at a local fake).

bot_token_secret.description: Secret-store name of the bot token.

guilds.description: Guilds (servers) that may talk to this daemon.

Git.description:
Agent commit attribution (`[git]`, A14): the identity any git the
engine's shell tool runs commits under. `None` keeps today's behavior
(no env pinned); a set field pulls its per-username default.

Grants.description:
Operator grants (`[grants]`): what the engine may do without an
approval card — pre-approved directories, installs, or everything.

advisory.description:
Keep the one-line full-access advisory in `status` and `doctor`
(`false` silences it; the access itself is unchanged).

full.description:
Full access: the OS sandbox is off, installs are granted and
path denies are ignored. ka-agent's own files stay protected.

install.description:
App/package installs (`sudo apt-get install`, `npm i -g`,
`pip install`, `cargo install`, `go install`, `nix-env -i`, …)
run without asking; `false` denies them naming this switch.

command.description:
`sh -c <command>` (agent events) / the engine's own hook contract
(engine events).

on.description:
The event to react to: an agent event (`message_received`,
`turn_finished`, `approval_requested`, `approval_settled`,
`reminder_fired`, `cron_finished`, `session_paused`,
`memory_proposed`) or an engine event (`pre_tool_use`,
`post_tool_use`, `user_prompt_submit`, `session_start`,
`session_end`, `stop`, `turn_end`, `pre_compact`,
`subagent_start`, `subagent_stop`, `pre_model_switch`,
`post_model_switch`, `post_compact`, `permission_request`,
`permission_denied`).

timeout_secs.description:
Hook timeout in seconds (1–60; unset = the runner's default, 10).
An agent event keeps it here; an engine event is forwarded as the
engine's own `timeout_secs` (the engine takes 1–600 and defaults
to 10, so every value this file accepts is valid there too).

tool.description: Only this tool (engine tool-call events only).

engine_layer.description:
Optional ka engine layer (ka's own strict `ka.toml` format), validated
with `Config::parse_layer` by the worker.

homeserver.description: Base URL of the homeserver; tests point it at a local fake.

token_secret.description: Name of the access token in the secret store.

McpServer.description:
One operator-declared MCP server (`[[mcp]]`). Values written
`secret:<name>` in `env`/`headers` resolve from the secret store when the
worker starts, so tokens never live in the config file.

name.description: Tool prefix: tools appear to the model as `<name>.<tool>`.

roles.description:
Roles allowed to see this server (absent = every role, including
admin). A user whose role is not listed gets the server subtracted.

Memory.description:
Memory extraction gating (`[memory]`, B15c) plus phase B1 recall and
embedding settings. Every default keeps today's behavior: no automatic
recall, no embeddings.

extraction_min_turns.description:
Recorded turns a session needs before `memory_propose` is allowed
(the warm-up gate); `0` turns the gate off.

max_context_tokens.description:
Hard cap for the per-prompt memory context, including the compiled
`MEMORY.md` estimate and the recall block.

MemoryDream.description:
Background memory extraction (`[memory.dream]`). Off by default; the
`/memory dream` command runs one pass when enabled.

idle_hours.description: A session must be idle this long before it is eligible.

max_candidates.description: Maximum candidates one pass may create.

min_turns.description: Eligible turns a session needs before extraction runs.

MemoryEmbeddings.description:
Optional embedding backend (`[memory.embeddings]`). `provider = "none"`
keeps the FTS-only path.

api_key.description:
API key or `secret:<name>` reference. Never a literal secret in
the config file.

base_url.description:
Base URL for an HTTP endpoint. `/v1/embeddings` is appended when
the URL does not already name the embeddings path.

dimensions.description: Expected dimension; `None` discovers it from the backend.

provider.description:
`none`, `openai` (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), `ollama`
(alias for the compatible endpoint), or `local` (fastembed).

timeout_secs.description: Per-request timeout for the HTTP backend.

budget_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for the block itself.

enabled.description: Inject the bounded `<recalled_memory>` block into interactive turns.

top_k.description: Maximum number of items in the block.

MemoryRerank.description:
Optional reranker (`[memory.rerank]`): a local cross-encoder that
re-scores recalled candidates by how well each answers the query. Off
by default; it needs a `local-embeddings` build.

enabled.description: Rerank the recalled candidates with the local cross-encoder.

model.description:
Reranker name. Unset keeps `BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3`, a
multilingual model (about 2.3 GB, downloaded on first use under
`<data>/models`).

quiet_hours.description:
`"22:00-07:00"`: scheduled prompts (crons, the briefing) that fall
due inside this local window wait until it ends. Reminders and
approvals are never held.

access.description: The grant's reach: allow | ask | deny (`always` = allow).

Recap.description:
Idle recaps (`[recap]`): after this many idle minutes the engine's
fast role summarizes where the session stands. The note reaches the
runtime as a recap event and is recorded on the strand
(`x.ka.recap`). The engine needs a fast role for it: `[roles] fast`,
which the engine layer composes from `background_model` when that is
set.

idle_minutes.description:
Minutes of quiet before a recap fires (1–1440). `0` (default)
keeps the engine's idle task off.

Retention.description:
Retention knobs (D12): 0 = keep forever, the default (an internal tool
keeps everything unless an organization asks otherwise).

attachments_days.description: Delete attachment files older than this many days.

strands_days.description:
Delete session strand files older than this many days — the
engine's own transcript, which a resumed session replays. Only a
strand nothing needs goes: never that of a session with a live
worker, an open turn or a turn still in the store.

turns_days.description: Delete turns (and their search rows) older than this many days.

RoleSpec.description:
One role (`[[role]]`): a linked identity's slice of the instance.
`admin` is implicit (terminal, web panel, CLI) and cannot be defined.

allow.description:
Per-turn allowlist of exact hand names. Mutually exclusive with
`disable`.

budget_daily_usd.description: Daily USD cap for the role (unset = the profile budget applies).

commands.description: Chat-command allowlist (unset = every command the role may reach).

disable.description: Subtractive engine feature specs for this role's workers.

escalate.description:
Tools that always escalate to the admin (D9): exact hand names and
`mcp:<server>[:<tool>]` — same spec grammar as `allow`.

grants.description:
Role grants; only `path` is honored (`install`/`full`/`advisory`
stay admin-only and are refused when set non-default).

mode.description:
Permission-mode ceiling AND default for the role's sessions
(`ask|accept_edits|allow|readonly`, old aliases accepted).

RuntimeSettings.description:
Engine supervision (`[runtime]`): how many workers may run at once and
whether each one is wrapped in the engine bubblewrap profile (ADR-0003).

max_workers.description:
Live engine workers at once (1..=64). Over the cap an idle worker is
evicted; if every worker is busy the message queues for a slot.

sandbox_engine.description:
Wrap each worker in the engine bubblewrap profile (mount + PID
namespace, shared network). Off by default: the P0 spike measured
2.7x startup and +12% memory (ADR-0003).

Scout.description: Read-only research children (`[scout]`, v4 F13/C1 slice).

enabled.description: Offer `kagent__scout` to the model at all.

max_concurrent.description:
Children allowed to run at once (the rest queue; over the queue a
spawn answers busy).

max_summary_chars.description: Cap on the summary returned to the parent (chars).

timeout_secs.description:
Per-child deadline in seconds — kept under the `__mcp` relay's
120 s IPC read timeout.

Search.description: Web search for the engine's `web_search` tool: strict `[search]`.

SlackSettings.description:
The Slack workspace app (`[slack]`): one app install serves the whole
workspace, so the daemon must be the single process answering it.

api_base.description: API base (tests point it at a local fake).

app_token_secret.description:
Secret-store name of the app-level token (`xapp-…`,
`connections:write`) used only to open the Socket Mode connection.

auto_provision.description:
Create a user for an unknown sender in an allowed workspace (named
after the platform handle, with `channels.default_role`).

bot_token_secret.description: Secret-store name of the bot token (`xoxb-…`) used for Web API calls.

teams.description:
Workspaces that may talk to this daemon (`T0123…`). Everything else
is ignored with one audit row.

allow_user_ids.description:
Deprecated: paired operator user ids. Migrated into the identities
table at startup (SEED.md §8.1); link identities with
`ka-agent identity link` instead.

api_base.description:
Bot API base URL. Default `https://api.telegram.org`; tests point it
at a local fake server.

enabled.description: Enable the Telegram channel in the daemon.

stream.description:
Stream replies as they are written (Bot API `sendMessageDraft`,
private chats). Falls back to the finished message by itself when
the API refuses drafts. Default on.

token_secret.description: Name of the bot token in the secret store.

Tools.description:
The profile-wide engine feature baseline (`[tools]`): subtractive specs
in the engine's own `[features] disable` grammar. Every worker spawns
with them (the admin role included); a role may narrow further.

disable.description: Engine feature specs disabled for every worker.

TurnWatchdog.description:
The turn watchdog: a staged deadline for a wedged-but-alive engine.
`silent_secs` after the last engine event a "still working" notice
goes out (once per turn); `abort_secs` after the last event the turn
is aborted like `/stop`. `0` disables either stage.

abort_secs.description: Seconds of engine silence before the turn is aborted; `0` = never.

silent_secs.description: Seconds of engine silence before the "still working" notice.

Voice.description:
Voice-note transcription: strict `[voice]`. OpenAI-compatible
`/audio/transcriptions` — OpenAI, Groq, or a local Whisper server.

model.description: Transcription model; a sensible default per provider.

Web.description: The local web control panel: strict `[web]` section.

bind.description:
Interface to bind (`127.0.0.1` by default; `0.0.0.0` only with TLS
or a reverse proxy in front — see `docs/design/web-relay.md`).

public_url.description:
Public base URL printed in login/pairing links
(e.g. `https://agent.example.com`). `None` = the local URL.

backoff_start_ms.description: First backoff after a worker crash.

crash_window_secs.description:
Crash-loop window and threshold: N crashes inside the window degrade
the session.

$schema.description: Editor hint: the URL of this schema. Ignored by the daemon.

approval_ttl_secs.description: Approval card TTL; deny on expiry.

background_model.description:
Model for background turns (crons, the briefing, `--background`
asks and `-bg` sources); `None` uses the main model.

busy_messages.description:
A message that arrives mid-turn: `steer` (default, rides the
running reply) or `queue` (durable, next turn).

effort.description:
Reasoning effort sent to the engine (`off|low|medium|high|max`);
`None` keeps the model's own default.

fallback.description:
Models tried in order when the main one fails (outage, rate
limit); at most two hops per turn.

grants.description: Operator grants (`[grants]`): paths, installs, full access.

interrupts.description:
Bare interrupt keywords (`stop`, `wait`, …): `on` (default) aborts
the running turn when such a short message arrives mid-cycle and
makes it the next one; `off` keeps the plain `busy_messages`
behavior.

language.description:
Operator language for assistant replies and channel chrome
(`en` | `es`; default `en`).

mode.description:
`ask` (default) | `accept_edits` | `allow` | `readonly`. The old
names (`guarded`, `free`, `plan`, `accept-edits`) are accepted
forever and normalized at load ([`normalize_mode`]).

model.description: Default ka model selector for new sessions.

role.description: Roles for linked identities (`[[role]]`); `admin` is implicit.

runtime.description:
Engine supervision (`[runtime]`): worker pool size and the engine
sandbox.

sandbox.description:
OS sandbox for bash: `auto` (default: fs when a backend exists) |
`fs` | `off`.

search.description: Web search for the engine (`None` = the `web_search` tool is off).

timezone.description:
Operator timezone (IANA name, e.g. `Europe/Madrid`). `None` uses the
system zone (UTC when it cannot be determined).

voice.description: Voice-note transcription (`None` = voice notes get a setup hint).

worker_idle_timeout_secs.description:
Stop an engine worker after this many idle seconds (no live turn,
no pending ask) to release its process; the next message restarts
it and resumes the strand. `0` keeps the worker forever. A resident
daemon that answers once a day should not pay 24/7 for it.

workspace.description:
The single workspace directory every engine runs in (MVP). The
default lives under the default data root — a relative default
would silently create `ka-agent-workspace/` wherever the operator
happened to stand.
